verdict.rationale: Segment publishes official SDKs across multiple languages (C#, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, Swift) plus a documented Public API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec and interactive reference for building integrations, giving developers (including AI-native ones) concrete, first-party surfaces to build against. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, explicit agent-framework or AI-tool SDK usage examples beyond the 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor' catalog links, and any dedicated AI/agent SDK documentation.
